name: Abstinence Total
overview: Scripture teaches that total abstinence from intoxicating beverages is a mark of holiness and separation unto the Lord, as seen in Leviticus 10:9-10 where Aaron and his sons are commanded not to drink wine or strong drink when entering the tabernacle to distinguish the holy from the unholy. The Nazarite vow, described in Numbers 6:3-4, further emphasizes complete separation from wine and any product of the vine as a sign of dedication to God. Deuteronomy 29:6 highlights that the Israelites refrained from bread and strong drink in the wilderness to recognize the LORD their God, underscoring abstinence as an act of spiritual focus and obedience.
